messages:
alice.m: Quick question — we're planning a short-lived SIEM archive export flow for incident-1234 (post-vuln triage). Need alignment on who gets key-unwrap rights and what RBAC + audit trail we require.
ben.security: 👍 What slice/TTL are you thinking? Also do we need plaintext in the export or can we keep tokenized PII?
carla-ctx: We should avoid raw PII unless Forensics absolutely needs it. Prefer tokenized exports + a separate unmask request with approval.
devops_jamie: Proposed flow: export controller produces encrypted bundle in S3 with envelope key wrapped by our KMS. Unwrap requires both `role:siem-archiver` and an escalation approval from SOC (2FA step). TTL default 6h, max 24h.
alice.m: That sounds reasonable. For incident-1234 we only need 8h access and tokenization for emails/phones. Can we automate the SOC approval via the incident ticket?
ben.security: Automating is OK but require manual second approver for any export with user identifiers. Ticket should contain: purpose, owner, expiration, justification. Example template: ```purpose: incident-1234
owned_by: service-oncall
export_ttl: 8h
redaction: tokenize
approval: soc_lead```
carla-ctx: Also add `audit_digest` field that records KMS key id + requestor + approvals so we can store fingerprinted proof. We need 7 years retention for the audit digest per compliance.
incident-bot: [ALERT] New export request created: #INC-1234 by service-oncall — pending SOC approval (link: https://redwood.tickets/INC-1234) :mag:
devops_jamie: On KMS side, prefer HSM-wrapped KEKs. No team member should have Unwrap permission except the `kms-proxy` service principal. Human access is via the `unwrap-session` job that requires SOC sign-off.
ben.security: Can someone outline RBAC changes? I propose: `group:siem-archiver` can request exports (issue bundle), `group:siem-unwrapper` can initiate unwrap-session (requires 2 approvers), `group:forensics` has conditional access windows only.
alice.m: I can open the RBAC PR. Question: do we create a temporary role binding for the oncall user or always go through service accounts?
carla-ctx: Always service account. Temp human bindings are messy and often forget to revoke. If an analyst needs ad-hoc access, they escalate and the controller mints a short-lived credential tied to the ticket.
devops_jamie: Implementation note — controller will emit an immutable audit record to `audit-log:siem-exports` with fields: `bundle_id`, `kms_key_id`, `requestor`, `approvers`, `unwrapped_by`, `unwrapped_at`, `export_ttl`, `redaction_policy`. That log is write-once and signed.
ben.security: Good. Also add an automated integrity check for the bundle hash whenever unwrap happens.
alice.m: Minor operational ask — can we have a `dry-run` flag on the export command so we can validate query and size estimates without generating a real bundle?
devops_jamie: Yep. CLI example: ```/siem-export --slice "2025-02-10..2025-02-12" --query "error.code:500" --ttl 8h --redaction tokenize --dry-run```
carla-ctx: For legal holds: if Legal places a hold, TTL must be extended and approvals go through Legal + SOC. That will be an exception flow logged separately.
ben.security: Risk note — exporting aggregated traces that contain tokenized IDs could still be deanonymized in small corp datasets. Keep exports scoped and prefer role-scoped sampling.
alice.m: OK let's capture: 1) RBAC groups + service accounts, 2) KMS unwrap via proxy only, 3) ticket-based approval with two approvers for any PII, 4) tokenize by default, 5) immutable audit digest retained 7y, 6) dry-run support. Anyone object?
carla-ctx: No objections. 👍
ben.security: I'm good. Approving but want the PR to include the exact audit schema.
devops_jamie: I'll draft the controller PR and the terraform RBAC change. Will post links here when ready.
alice.m: Thanks — I'll draft the incident playbook steps for IR and Forensics to use this flow and attach the example command and the ticket template.
incident-bot: [INFO] SOC approval granted by @ben.security at 3629001160 for export INC-1234 :white_check_mark:
alice.m: Approved and proceeding to run a dry-run now. Will update ticket with size estimate.
